## What each component measures

| Component | Format | What it measures |
|---|---|---|
| Module quizzes | Online, 20 min, open Friday to Thursday; lowest two dropped | Concepts and short code reading from the week |
| Lab submissions | GitHub pull requests; auto-run in CI plus TA review | Correct, readable code and written interpretation of every result |
| Module assignments | One per module, rubric in each module guide | Applying the module to a new problem, honestly reported |
| Term exams | Three proctored 4-hour exams (Weeks 11, 27, 47) | Theory, numericals, code reading; no AI tools |
| Capstone | Pre-registration, midpoint, research review, four weeks of paper trading, report, viva | The whole job, end to end ([capstone](06-capstone.md)) |

Paper-trading P&L is **not** graded on profit. It is graded on discipline: following the
pre-registered rules, respecting limits, keeping a journal and explaining deviations from the
backtest. A well-run study that finds no edge can earn a Distinction; a profitable backtest built on
leakage cannot pass.

## Lab grading rubric (applies to every lab)

| Criterion | Marks | Full marks look like |
|---|---|---|
| Runs | 20 | The lab runs cleanly from a fresh environment; CI green |
| Correctness | 30 | Numbers match the reference within tolerance; exercises answered |
| Interpretation | 30 | Every table and chart explained in plain language, including what it does *not* show |
| Code quality | 20 | Readable, small functions, no copy-paste, tests where new functions were written |

Planned labs are replaced by their module's exercise pack, graded with the same rubric.

## Requirements for the certificate

1. Overall score at or above the Pass band, with the capstone at or above its band minimum.
2. Attendance of at least 80% of live sessions (recordings do not count) and all three bootcamps.
3. Every ready lab submitted.
4. No upheld academic-integrity violation.

The certificate carries a unique credential ID that employers can verify online, with a transcript
listing modules, hours and grade band. It is a certificate of the institute. It is not a degree, a
SEBI registration or a NISM certification; NISM exams are taken separately with the included
vouchers.

## Re-sits and resubmissions

- One re-sit per term exam within 4 weeks, capped at the Pass mark.
- Late lab or assignment submissions within 7 days lose 20% of the marks; after that they score zero but still count as submitted.
- A failed capstone may be resubmitted once within 3 months, for a Pass at most.

## Academic integrity and AI use

- Code and reports must be the learner's own. Discussing ideas is encouraged; copying code without attribution is not.
- AI assistants (code assistants and LLMs) may be used for labs, assignments and the capstone if the learner discloses how in a short note and can explain every line in the viva.
- AI tools are not allowed in proctored exams.
- Fabricated results, undisclosed data snooping, undeclared trials or misreported paper trading fail the capstone.

## Feedback timelines

| Item | Feedback within |
|---|---|
| Quizzes | Instant |
| Labs and assignments | 7 days, written |
| Term exams | 14 days |
| Capstone | Jury feedback on Demo Day; final grade within 10 days |

## Moderation

A second marker reviews 10% of labs and assignments per module and every borderline exam and
capstone (within 3 marks of a band boundary). Jury scores are the median of three independent
scores.
